A **residual** is the difference
between an observed value
and its corresponding [fitted value](#def-fitted-value), $\hat y$:
$$
\ba
\resid &\eqdef y - \hat y
\ea
$$

For indexed observations,
the residual is defined as:
$$
\resid_i \eqdef y_i - \hat y_i
$$

For a particular fitted model,
each residual $\resid_i$
is tied to its corresponding fitted value $\hat y_i$.
The fitted value $\hat y_i$ is often
a [sample mean](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/exploratory-descriptive.html#def-sample-mean) or fitted [conditional mean](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-cond-expectation),
but not always.
